text: Near the left side of the penalty area at Kingsmoor FC’s end, Viktor Quinlan steps up to take a penalty from 9.7 metres out. He strikes the ball firmly with his foot towards the goal. The shot hits the back of the net, putting Kingsmoor FC ahead 1-0 against Westport Albion after just eight minutes. This follows a foul by Westport’s Joon Sato one minute earlier, which earned Kingsmoor the penalty chance.
